question.en: A partially completed class diagram is given for a chocolate factory system. Draw a sequence diagram for the following scenario so that it is consistent with the class diagram, and then complete the class diagram with the necessary methods, attributes, and relationships. Departments are responsible for chocolate production. For that purpose, a chocolate is first selected, and then the ingredients required for its preparation are retrieved. For each ingredient, a check is performed to determine whether it is available in stock by invoking the method is_available(): bool of class Ingredient. If all ingredients required for the chocolate are available in stock, a return message is sent to class Department, after which the chocolate is added to the preparation list; otherwise, information is sent about the ingredients that need to be procured.

question.en: A partially drawn class diagram for a system for museums is given (classes User, Exhibition, Ticket). Draw a sequence diagram for the following text that will be consistent with the class diagram and then complete the class diagram with the necessary methods, attributes, and relations. Users of the system for museums can buy tickets for visiting museum exhibitions. To buy a ticket, the user first selects an exhibition and chooses a date. Then a message to check whether there are free slots is sent to the class Exhibition. If there is a free slot, a message is returned to the user. Then the user inserts the necessary information and sends a message buy_ticket() that sends the information to the class Exhibition. This message creates a new object from the class Ticket.
